name: AgriSleuth
track: Track 2 - The Agent That Can Explain Why
description: An evidence-backed crop investigation agent that explains why a hypothesis is supported, what contradicts it, and what the researcher should verify next.

sponsor_technology.Zetaris: Real SQL API queries over a read-only PostgreSQL JDBC evidence view; no direct disease-search fallback.
sponsor_technology.Meterless: Unmodified Markovian reference runtime governs bounded Controller-selected tool actions, checkpoints and completion; PostgreSQL stores run state. Token accounting is estimated.

limitations: KMA live observations require authorized access
Image and diagnosis accuracy have not been evaluated on a labeled dataset
Critic may request supplied or stage-irrelevant context; scenario choice is not biological validation

agent_policy.completion_requires: Fresh source/crop-valid hypotheses and passing Critic/Judge, with unchanged evidence and claims

verification.weather_live_status: KMA BUFR SYNOP: 8/8 timestamps on three tested Seoul dates; NOAA station metadata; full agent weather-inclusive replay pending
verification.environment_sample: Latest: 141.2 s, cached weather, Zetaris search, Diagnosis/Critic/Judge, all tools completed, needs_more_evidence; WEATHER_WINDOW_GAP direct. Previous fresh-weather run 156.6 s. One sample, no accuracy estimate.

critic_scenarios.selection: direct match or nearest scenario with explicit rationale; validated known IDs

configuration.transport: Direct validated Python tools with HTTP/SQL/Node bridge; MCP not required by this build
